svg.title: Level-of-service bands mapped onto the speed–density and flow–density fundamental diagrams
svg.desc: Two stacked fundamental diagrams sharing a common density axis. Vertical dashed lines at densities of 11, 18, 26, 35 and 45 passenger cars per mile per lane mark the boundaries of levels of service A through E, all of which lie on the free-flow branch. Everything beyond the critical density of 45, the whole congested branch, is level of service F.
